description: Looks up a quote started earlier, by its quote_id. Returns the quote's status, whether options are ready, and what's still needed. Saved personal details are returned only to the same platform user who started the quote.

quote_id.description: The quote session id to resume.

verification.description: Ownership verification (email code, platform identity, or magic link); required to return PII.

code.description: The verification code (for the email_code method).

method.description: Verification method: email code, platform-identity header, or magic-link token.

token.description: The verification token (for the magic_link method).

name: resume_quote

outputSchema.description: Resumed quote status (PII only on a verified call).

title: Resume a quote
